description: TOGETHER: respect origin cache headers and exclude dynamic requests

rules.description: Public site respects origin freshness and browser cache headers
Never cache writes, WordPress APIs/admin, tracking or authenticated previews
rules.expression: (http.host in {"togetherprivacy.tech" "www.togetherprivacy.tech"}) and (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/h8ny") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php") or http.request.uri.query contains "rest_route=" or http.request.uri.query contains "preview=" or http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_" or http.cookie contains "wp-postpass_")
